column1: # Committed exact selections for the restricted-egress gate and the recipe
# audits. NEVER resolved from a live "latest": the default column mirrors the
# Dockerfile ARG defaults and the alternate column is the captured exact
# alternate (registry metadata, reviewed 2026-10-15). Update by running
# `script/build/agent-versions.sh --write` / the lock bump tools, then the
# tests, then commit -- never by a test fetching the current latest.
# codex and agy have no alternate: their payloads are bound by a committed content
# pin, so an arbitrary exact version is not installable and a second unshipped pin
# closure would be a second truth. `-` means "one committed selection, no alternate".
